library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-couchbase 4.1.1 needs no setup beyond the normal scaffold. Its POM declares com.couchbase.client:java-client:3.11.3 at compile scope, so the client arrives transitively. The sibling tests for spring-boot-data-couchbase 4.1.1 and the Couchbase client run without Docker or system properties, and the allowed-docker-images directory has no Couchbase image.
risks: The module holds auto-configuration (CouchbaseAutoConfiguration, ClusterEnvironment customizers and properties). Tests probably need spring-boot-autoconfigure and spring-boot-test as testImplementation dependencies, as the sibling spring-boot-data-couchbase test project adds them. They may also need assertj. Add these if compilation fails; the build will show it.

Cluster connections need a live Couchbase server. Tests should stay on ApplicationContextRunner, properties binding and ClusterEnvironment/ClusterOptions customizer code paths, and should not call Cluster.connect against a real server.
